{{Quote|When the Demon King reached into me from inside the Dark Stone...When he whispered he would see all my dreams and desires made true...I...I did not reject him. In the shadows of my heart, he saw jealousy...vanity...It was my weakness that put these emotions there, allowed them to thrive.|[[Lyon]]}}

'''Sacred Stone''' (Japanese: {{hl|聖魔の光石|Seima no kōseki}} ''Light Stones of Saints and Demons'') is the final chapter of {{FE8}}. This page covers the first part of the chapter.

It is not possible to return to the [[world map]] during this chapter.

==Plot==
{{main|Sacred Stone (part 1)/Script (Eirika)|Sacred Stone (part 1)/Script (Ephraim)}}

Eirika's route begins with a flashback to a year and a half prior, when [[Lyon]] and [[Eirika]] bid each other farewell; Eirika reaffirms that he, she, and [[Ephraim]] will always be friends, and Lyon resolves to progress his research into [[Grado]]'s [[Sacred Stone (object)|Sacred Stone]] for universal good. In the present day, the group reaches Lyon in the Black Temple; Lyon apologizes to Eirika for his weakness against [[Fomortiis|the Demon King]] before being overtaken by him and initiating a battle.

Ephraim's route similarly begins with a flashback to a year and a half ago, when Lyon and Ephraim say goodbye to each other. Lyon wonders if they will drift apart in the future, but Ephraim believes they will always be friends, even if [[Renais]] and Grado go to war. In the present day, the group reaches Lyon in the Black Temple. Ephraim asks Lyon if it is his fault Lyon changed, but Lyon tells him it is not; Ephraim resolves to defeat Lyon, but Lyon boasts that he cannot be defeated.

After the battle, once Lyon is defeated, the twins speak to him before he dies. Lyon tells Eirika that he is in love with her; he tells Ephraim that he is jealous of him, but Ephraim says he looked up to Lyon for his kindness. Once Lyon is dead, Fomortiis takes Lyon's body as a vessel for his resurrection.

====Reinforcements====
*After entering the western part of the map (columns 1–12, rows 8–13)
**4 [[Deathgoyle]]s from the northeast
*After entering the eastern part of the map (columns 13–23, rows 8–13)
**5 [[Arch Mogall]]s from the northwest
*For 10 turns after a unit waits on the stairs below Lyon (columns 11–13, rows 6–7)
**3 [[Wight]]s from the stairs above of Lyon; these Wights are randomly set individually to be the melee or ranged variation, with an 80% chance to be melee and a 20% chance to be ranged
*Note: These reinforcement triggers and locations are based on Eirika's route. On Ephraim's route, the trigger areas and spawn points are horizontally mirrored.

==Strategy==
{{strategy}}
Your units deployed on this map carry over to the final boss and are arranged based on deployment order. Bring [[Tethys]] on this map if at all possible, even if you don't normally use her, as she will allow an additional character to attack the final boss on turn 1 before he starts attacking and make him much easier to deal with.  

Nothing on this map prevents you from advancing slowly and carefully. Take an extra chest key or two to save needing to skip a chest or bring a thief. The necrodragons are best handled by exploiting their low range to get them away from other units: Once they've been provoked, they will keep following even if you retreat. As with Morva last level, high raw HP is the only true defense against them, but their lower Strength (and other stats) mean the selection of units that can survive them isn't nearly as dire.

Save yourself the trouble of fighting 30 wights by never stepping on the staircase below Lyon. Just go around and these reinforcements will never spawn. Lyon doesn't actually move, and isn't even on a gate or throne, so he shouldn't be hard to defeat if you didn't trigger the wight reinforcements.
